notes.title: Thể sai khiến chủ động (Active causatives)
notes.body:
Dùng khi ta nhờ/yêu cầu/thuê NGƯỜI KHÁC làm việc gì cho mình.
• have + sb + V (nguyên mẫu không to): The manager had the technician install the software.
• get + sb + to V: I'll get someone to take a picture of us. (sách – Getting Started)
• Phân biệt: make + sb + V = bắt buộc ai làm gì (The teacher made us rewrite the essay); let + sb + V = cho phép.
• Have/get chia theo thì của câu: I'm having / I had / I will get…
Lỗi hay gặp: *get sb do* (thiếu to), *have sb to do* (thừa to).

notes.title: Thể sai khiến bị động (Passive causatives)
notes.body:
Dùng khi muốn nhấn mạnh VIỆC được làm cho mình (không cần nêu/hoặc nêu sau by người làm).
• have + sth + V3/ed (+ by sb): We have all visitors' identity checked to improve the centre security. (sách)
• get + sth + V3/ed: Let me get this robot activated, so you can talk to him. (sách)
• Let's have a photo taken together! (sách)
• Chia thì ở have/get: She is having her laptop repaired. / We had a new AI lab built last year. / I'm going to get my phone screen replaced.
• Chuyển đổi: A technician repaired my robot. → I had my robot repaired by a technician.
• Cũng dùng cho việc không may xảy ra với mình: He had his phone stolen.
Lỗi hay gặp: dùng V-ing hoặc V nguyên mẫu sau tân ngữ chỉ vật (*have the robot check*); nhầm 'had it fixed' (nhờ sửa) với 'had fixed it' (quá khứ hoàn thành – tự sửa).

notes.title: Từ đồng âm (Homophones)
notes.body:
Homophones là những từ phát âm giống nhau nhưng khác chính tả và nghĩa. Vd: I have two books, too. (/tuː/)
Các cặp trong sách: to – two /tuː/; there – their /ðeə(r)/; where – wear /weə(r)/; board – bored /bɔːd/; hour – our /ˈaʊə(r)/; allowed – aloud /əˈlaʊd/; know – no /nəʊ/; right – write /raɪt/.
Thêm: see – sea, buy – by, new – knew, hear – here, weather – whether.
Lưu ý chữ câm: h trong hour, honest; k trong know; w trong write, wrong, answer.
Khi nghe/viết phải dựa vào NGỮ CẢNH để chọn đúng từ: We want to know where AI technologies are used. / Robots can work for long hours.

notes.title: Collocation / cụm từ cần nhớ
notes.body:
• artificial intelligence (AI); facial recognition; voice recognition; virtual assistant; human-like robot
• be capable of + V-ing (có khả năng làm gì); interact with sb/sth (tương tác với)
• practical applications of AI (ứng dụng thực tế); advanced technology (công nghệ tiên tiến)
• programme a robot to do sth; analyse data; activate a robot
• personalised learning; give instant feedback; assess students' work
• take over the world (thống trị/chiếm quyền kiểm soát); rely on (phụ thuộc vào); replace humans
• do household chores; give voice commands; protect privacy; a robot malfunctions

notes.title: Kỹ năng – Everyday English: Getting attention and interrupting
notes.body:
Thu hút sự chú ý: Excuse me, … / Sorry to bother you, but … / Can I have your attention, please?
Ngắt lời lịch sự: Sorry to interrupt, but … / Can I just say something? / May I interrupt for a second? / Sorry, can I add something here?
Đáp lại: Yes, go ahead. / Sure, what is it?

notes.title: Mẹo làm bài
notes.body:
• Gặp have/get + tân ngữ: tân ngữ là NGƯỜI làm việc → have sb V / get sb to V; tân ngữ là VẬT được làm → have/get sth V3.
• Câu viết lại 'Someone did sth for me' → 'I had/got sth done (by someone)'; giữ đúng thì của câu gốc.
• Câu tìm lỗi: kiểm tra từ đồng âm (there/their, where/wear, hour/our, know/no) và giới từ đi kèm (capable of, interact with, rely on).
• Word form: sau mạo từ/tính từ sở hữu cần danh từ (applications, recognition, privacy); sau trợ động từ cần động từ (analyse, activate, operate).
• Phát âm: nhớ chữ câm (h-our, k-now, w-rite) và đuôi -ed /ɪd/ sau t, d (activated).

vocab.ex: She's a human-like robot and will be your guide today.
Let's go first to the robot exhibition.
They look so real! Can we interact with them?

vocab.vi: có khả năng (be capable of + V-ing)
vocab.ex: They're all capable of answering questions.
The robots can translate from different languages.

vocab.vi: kích hoạt, làm cho hoạt động
vocab.ex: Let me get this robot activated so you can talk to him.
AI has many practical applications.
Voice recognition lets you control the device by speaking.
I noticed a facial recognition screen at the entrance of the centre.
Virtual assistants can set reminders and answer simple questions.
We have all visitors' identity checked.
We check visitors' identity to improve the centre security.
This is one of the most advanced robots in the world.

vocab.vi: chương trình trò chuyện tự động
vocab.ex: The chatbot can answer customers' questions 24 hours a day.
Artificial intelligence is changing the way we live and work.
Engineers programmed the robot to sort rubbish.
AI can analyse huge amounts of data in seconds.

vocab.vi: chiếm quyền kiểm soát, thống trị
vocab.ex: There have been some worries about AI taking over the world.
The app uses an algorithm to suggest suitable exercises.
AI systems learn from large amounts of data.
AI makes personalised learning possible.

vocab.vi: điều chỉnh cho phù hợp (adapt to)
vocab.ex: The programme adapts the lessons to each student's level.
Students get instant feedback on their pronunciation.
Teachers use AI tools to assess students' work.
The tests are marked automatically.
An AI tutor is available whenever students need help.
Teachers use software to check essays for plagiarism.
AI will never completely replace teachers.
The expert explains how to operate a home robot.
You can control the robot with simple voice commands.
Its sensors help the robot avoid bumping into furniture.
Home robots can help with household chores.
Some people worry about their privacy when using smart devices.

vocab.vi: gặp trục trặc, hoạt động sai
vocab.ex: If a robot malfunctions, it may cause accidents.
We shouldn't rely on robots for everything.
Sorry to interrupt, but can I ask a question?
The evolution of robots started with simple machines.
Industrial robots are used in car factories.
A humanoid can walk and talk like a human.
Robots can perform dangerous tasks.
Our group designed an innovative AI application for farmers.
The centre shows cutting-edge AI technology.

passages.title: AI in the classroom
passages.text: Artificial intelligence is changing the way students learn in many parts of the world. One of the most useful (1) _____ of AI in education is personalised learning. Instead of following the same lesson as everyone else, each student can work with an AI tutor (2) _____ adapts the exercises to his or her level. If a student makes a mistake, the programme gives instant feedback and explains the correct answer. Teachers also benefit from AI. Many schools now have homework (3) _____ automatically, so teachers can spend more time preparing lessons and supporting students who need help. AI tools can also analyse test results and show which topics a class finds difficult. (4) _____, AI in education has some disadvantages. Some students rely too much on chatbots and copy their answers instead of thinking for themselves. Therefore, schools should teach students to use AI tools responsibly and (5) _____ them as helpful assistants, not as a replacement for their own effort.

passages.title: Robots at home
passages.text: Home robots are no longer something we only see in science-fiction films. Today, many families have robot vacuum cleaners that can clean the floor while their owners are at work. More (6) _____ models can even cook simple meals, remind elderly people to take their medicine, and call for help in an emergency. Most home robots are easy to (7) _____. You just give them voice commands or use an app on your smartphone. Their sensors help them recognise objects and avoid bumping into furniture. However, home robots also have some drawbacks. They are still quite expensive, and some people worry about their (8) _____ because the robots collect personal data. Robots may also malfunction, so owners sometimes have to get a technician (9) _____ them. In the future, home robots will probably become cheaper and more intelligent. They will not replace humans completely, but they will make our daily lives (10) _____ easier.

questions.q: A _____ is a computer programme that can have a conversation with a human, usually over the Internet.
questions.explain: chatbot = chương trình máy tính có thể trò chuyện với con người qua Internet. sensor: cảm biến; algorithm: thuật toán; website: trang web – không phải chương trình trò chuyện.

questions.q: The robots in the exhibition are all capable _____ answering questions in different languages.
questions.explain: Cấu trúc be capable of + V-ing: có khả năng làm gì. Các giới từ in, for, at không đi với capable.

questions.q: Siri and Alexa are popular examples of virtual _____ that can set reminders and answer simple questions.
questions.explain: Collocation virtual assistant = trợ lý ảo. 'virtual machine' là máy ảo (khái niệm khác), servants/operators không kết hợp như vậy.

questions.q: Many smartphones now use facial _____ to unlock the screen.
questions.explain: facial recognition = nhận diện khuôn mặt. identity: danh tính; knowledge: kiến thức; decision: quyết định – không tạo cụm đúng.

questions.q: AI has many practical _____ such as facial recognition and virtual assistants.
questions.explain: Sau tính từ practical cần danh từ số nhiều: applications (các ứng dụng). applies/apply là động từ, applicable là tính từ.

questions.q: Engineers _____ the robot to sort rubbish into different bins.
questions.explain: programme sb/sth to do sth = lập trình cho máy làm gì. analyse: phân tích; interact cần with; recognise: nhận ra – không hợp nghĩa với cấu trúc 'to sort'.

questions.q: Doctors use AI to _____ huge amounts of medical data in a few seconds.
questions.explain: Sau to cần động từ nguyên mẫu: analyse (phân tích). analysis (n), analytical (adj), analyst (n – nhà phân tích).

questions.q: Some people worry that AI will _____ over the world one day.
questions.explain: take over = chiếm quyền kiểm soát, thống trị. get over: vượt qua; look over: xem qua; turn over: lật lại – không hợp nghĩa.

questions.q:
This is one of the most <u>advanced</u> robots in the world.
Choose the word CLOSEST in meaning to the underlined word.
questions.explain: advanced = tiên tiến, hiện đại ≈ modern. ancient: cổ xưa (trái nghĩa); simple: đơn giản; cheap: rẻ.

questions.q:
The robot looked so <u>real</u> that some visitors thought it was a person.
Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to the underlined word.
questions.explain: real (thật) trái nghĩa với artificial (nhân tạo, giả). natural, genuine, true đều gần nghĩa với real.

questions.q: Students can _____ with the chatbot in English to practise their speaking skills.
questions.explain: interact with sb/sth = tương tác với. reply phải đi với to (reply to sb); discuss là ngoại động từ, cần tân ngữ (discuss sth with sb) nên 'discuss with the chatbot' thiếu tân ngữ; contact sb không dùng with.

questions.q: Press this button to _____ the robot, and it will start talking to you.
questions.explain: Sau to cần động từ: activate (kích hoạt). active (adj), activity (n), actively (adv).

questions.q: AI-powered apps can give students _____ feedback on their pronunciation.
questions.explain: Trước danh từ feedback cần tính từ: instant (ngay lập tức). instantly là trạng từ; instance/instants là danh từ.

questions.q: In personalised learning, lessons are _____ to each student's needs and level.
questions.explain: be adapted to = được điều chỉnh cho phù hợp với. adopted: được áp dụng/nhận nuôi (dễ nhầm với adapted); admitted: được thừa nhận/nhận vào; attracted: bị thu hút.

questions.q:
Teachers can use AI tools to <u>assess</u> students' work more quickly.
Choose the word CLOSEST in meaning to the underlined word.
questions.explain: assess = đánh giá ≈ evaluate. create: tạo ra; copy: sao chép; ignore: phớt lờ.

questions.q: Copying someone else's work and pretending that it is your own is called _____.
questions.explain: plagiarism = đạo văn. privacy: sự riêng tư; recognition: sự nhận dạng; evolution: sự tiến hoá.

questions.q: Home robots can help elderly people with household _____ like cleaning and cooking.
questions.explain: Collocation household chores = việc nhà. work là danh từ không đếm được (không có 'works' với nghĩa này); homework là bài tập về nhà; labours không dùng như vậy.

questions.q: Many people are worried about their _____ because smart devices collect a lot of personal data.
questions.explain: Sau tính từ sở hữu their cần danh từ: privacy (sự riêng tư). private (adj), privately (adv), privatise (v).

questions.q:
Some people <u>rely on</u> virtual assistants for almost everything they do.
Choose the phrase CLOSEST in meaning to the underlined phrase.
questions.explain: rely on = dựa vào, phụ thuộc vào ≈ depend on. look after: chăm sóc; give up: từ bỏ; take off: cất cánh/cởi ra.

questions.q: If a robot _____, it may stop working or even do something dangerous.
questions.explain: malfunction = gặp trục trặc, hoạt động sai – hợp với hậu quả 'stop working'. operates/functions = hoạt động bình thường; programmes = lập trình – mâu thuẫn nghĩa.

questions.q: I'll get someone _____ a picture of us.
questions.explain: Thể sai khiến chủ động: get + sb + to V (nhờ ai làm gì). Không dùng V nguyên mẫu sau get + người; taken/to be taken là dạng bị động, không hợp vì 'someone' là người thực hiện.

questions.q: We had the robot _____ by an engineer yesterday.
questions.explain: Thể sai khiến bị động: have + sth + V3 (+ by sb). Robot là vật được sửa → repaired. Dịch: Hôm qua chúng tôi đã nhờ kỹ sư sửa con rô-bốt.

questions.q: The manager had the technician _____ the new software on all computers.
questions.explain: have + sb + V (nguyên mẫu không to): had the technician install. Sau have + người không dùng to V hay V3.

questions.q: Let's have a photo _____ together!
questions.explain: have + sth + V3: a photo là vật được chụp → taken (câu trong sách: Let's have a photo taken together!).

questions.q: My parents are going to _____ a smart security system installed next month.
questions.explain: Cấu trúc bị động sai khiến: have + sth + V3 (nhờ lắp đặt). make/let/ask không đi với tân ngữ chỉ vật + V3.

questions.q: She got her brother _____ the virtual assistant on her new phone.
questions.explain: get + sb + to V: nhờ/thuyết phục ai làm gì → to set up. Các dạng còn lại sai cấu trúc.

questions.q: We have all visitors' identity _____ to improve the centre security.
questions.explain: identity là vật được kiểm tra → have + sth + V3: checked (câu trong sách Getting Started).

questions.q: I'm going to get my laptop _____ because it keeps freezing.
questions.explain: get + sth + V3: get my laptop repaired (mang máy đi sửa). laptop không thể tự sửa nên không dùng to repair/repair/repairing.

questions.q: The teacher had the students _____ their essays through a plagiarism checker.
questions.explain: have + sb + V nguyên mẫu không to: had the students run. Không dùng to V, quá khứ hay hoàn thành sau have + người.

questions.q: Let me get this robot _____, so you can talk to him.
questions.explain: get + sth + V3: get this robot activated (cho rô-bốt được kích hoạt) – câu trong sách.

questions.q: Our school _____ a new AI lab built last year.
questions.explain: 'last year' → thì quá khứ đơn: had + sth + V3. has/is having/has had không dùng với mốc thời gian quá khứ xác định.

questions.q: We _____ our smart home system upgraded at the moment, so the lights don't work.
questions.explain: 'at the moment' → hiện tại tiếp diễn: are having + sth + V3. Have (hiện tại đơn), had (quá khứ), have had (hiện tại hoàn thành) không hợp.

questions.q: Where did you have your phone screen _____? It looks brand new.
questions.explain: have + sth + V3: have your phone screen replaced (nhờ thay màn hình). Trợ động từ did đã mang thì quá khứ.

questions.q:
A technician is going to check our computer network.
→ We are going to _____ our computer network checked by a technician.
questions.explain: Chuyển sang bị động sai khiến: have + sth + V3 (+ by sb). make/let không dùng với V3 theo nghĩa này; 'get to' sai (get + sth + V3 không có to).

questions.q: The company had its chatbot _____ to answer customers' questions in five languages.
questions.explain: chatbot là vật được lập trình → have + sth + V3: programmed.

questions.q: You should get a professional _____ your home robot instead of doing it yourself.
questions.explain: get + sb + to V: get a professional to repair (nhờ thợ chuyên nghiệp sửa). 'a professional' là người thực hiện nên không dùng dạng bị động.

questions.q: Facial recognition _____ in many airports nowadays.
questions.explain: Chủ ngữ facial recognition chịu tác động (được sử dụng) + nowadays → bị động hiện tại đơn: is used.

questions.q: AI tools can _____ to analyse large amounts of data.
questions.explain: Bị động với động từ khuyết thiếu: can + be + V3 → can be used (có thể được dùng).

questions.q: I didn't fix the robot myself. I _____.
questions.explain: Nhờ người khác sửa → had it fixed (have + sth + V3). 'had fixed it' là quá khứ hoàn thành (tự sửa) – mâu thuẫn câu đầu; 'got it fix', 'had it fix' sai dạng động từ.

questions.q: Did you write the code yourself? – No, I _____ by my brother.
questions.explain: Có 'by my brother' → bị động sai khiến: had it written by my brother. Các phương án khác sai cấu trúc hoặc sai nghĩa (had written it = tôi đã tự viết).

questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: human /ˈhjuːmən/ – h đọc /h/; hour /ˈaʊə(r)/, honest /ˈɒnɪst/, honour /ˈɒnə(r)/ – h câm (vì vậy hour đồng âm với our).

questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: allowed /əˈlaʊd/ – ow đọc /aʊ/ (đồng âm với aloud); know /nəʊ/, flow /fləʊ/, show /ʃəʊ/ – ow đọc /əʊ/.

questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: clear /klɪə(r)/ – ea đọc /ɪə/; wear /weə(r)/, bear /beə(r)/, pear /peə(r)/ – ea đọc /eə/ (wear đồng âm với where).

questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: chatbot /ˈtʃætbɒt/ – ch đọc /tʃ/; technology /tekˈnɒlədʒi/, mechanical /məˈkænɪkl/, character /ˈkærəktə(r)/ – ch đọc /k/.

questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: activated /ˈæktɪveɪtɪd/ – -ed đọc /ɪd/ (sau /t/); programmed /ˈprəʊɡræmd/, analysed /ˈænəlaɪzd/, allowed /əˈlaʊd/ – -ed đọc /d/.

questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: advanced /ədˈvɑːnst/ – a đọc /ə/; analyse /ˈænəlaɪz/, application /ˌæplɪˈkeɪʃn/, activate /ˈæktɪveɪt/ – a đọc /æ/.

questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: wear /weə(r)/ – w đọc /w/; write /raɪt/, wrong /rɒŋ/, answer /ˈɑːnsə(r)/ – w câm (vì vậy write đồng âm với right).

questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: digital /ˈdɪdʒɪtl/ – i đọc /ɪ/; right /raɪt/, write /raɪt/, device /dɪˈvaɪs/ – i đọc /aɪ/.

questions.q: Choose the word that differs from the others in the position of primary stress.
questions.explain: intelligence /ɪnˈtelɪdʒəns/ nhấn âm 2; application /ˌæplɪˈkeɪʃn/, recognition /ˌrekəɡˈnɪʃn/, information /ˌɪnfəˈmeɪʃn/ nhấn âm 3 (đuôi -tion nhấn âm ngay trước).

questions.q: Choose the word that differs from the others in the position of primary stress.
questions.explain: advanced /ədˈvɑːnst/ nhấn âm 2; activate /ˈæktɪveɪt/, analyse /ˈænəlaɪz/, programme /ˈprəʊɡræm/ nhấn âm 1.

questions.q: Choose the word that differs from the others in the position of primary stress.
questions.explain: artificial /ˌɑːtɪˈfɪʃl/ nhấn âm 3; technology /tekˈnɒlədʒi/, intelligent /ɪnˈtelɪdʒənt/, assistant /əˈsɪstənt/ nhấn âm 2.

questions.q: Choose the word that differs from the others in the position of primary stress.
questions.explain: machine /məˈʃiːn/ nhấn âm 2; robot /ˈrəʊbɒt/, chatbot /ˈtʃætbɒt/, human /ˈhjuːmən/ nhấn âm 1.

questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
We <u>had</u> (A) our robot <u>check</u> (B) <u>by</u> (C) a technician <u>last week</u> (D).
questions.explain: Lỗi ở B: have + sth + V3 → sửa check thành checked (had our robot checked).

questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
My father <u>got</u> (A) <u>the engineer</u> (B) <u>install</u> (C) a smart lock <u>on</u> (D) our front door.
questions.explain: Lỗi ở C: get + sb + to V → sửa install thành to install.

questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
Jessica <u>is capable</u> (A) <u>for</u> (B) <u>answering</u> (C) questions <u>in</u> (D) different languages.
questions.explain: Lỗi ở B: be capable of + V-ing → sửa for thành of.

questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
<u>There</u> (A) robots can <u>work</u> (B) for long <u>hours</u> (C) <u>without</u> (D) feeling tired.
questions.explain: Lỗi ở A: nhầm từ đồng âm. Trước danh từ robots cần tính từ sở hữu Their (của họ), không phải There. Sửa There → Their.

questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
AI is <u>widely</u> (A) <u>used</u> (B) in <u>applications</u> (C) such as facial <u>recognise</u> (D) and virtual assistants.
questions.explain: Lỗi ở D: sau tính từ facial cần danh từ → sửa recognise thành recognition (facial recognition).

questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
She <u>made</u> (A) her laptop <u>repaired</u> (B) <u>at</u> (C) the shop <u>near</u> (D) her house.
questions.explain: Lỗi ở A: thể sai khiến bị động dùng have/get + sth + V3, không dùng make → sửa made thành had/got.

questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
Some people <u>worry</u> (A) <u>that</u> (B) AI will <u>take off</u> (C) the world <u>in</u> (D) the future.
questions.explain: Lỗi ở C: take off = cất cánh/cởi ra. Nghĩa 'thống trị, chiếm quyền kiểm soát' là take over → sửa take off thành take over.

questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
The company <u>had</u> (A) its chatbot <u>programmed</u> (B) <u>to answer</u> (C) customers' questions <u>automatical</u> (D).
questions.explain: Lỗi ở D: bổ nghĩa cho động từ answer cần trạng từ → sửa automatical thành automatically.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.
A technician repaired my home robot yesterday.
options: I had my home robot repaired by a technician yesterday.
I repaired my home robot for a technician yesterday.
I had a technician repaired my home robot yesterday.
My home robot had a technician repair yesterday.
questions.explain: Bị động sai khiến: have + sth + V3 + by sb, giữ thì quá khứ. Các câu khác sai cấu trúc (had a technician repaired) hoặc sai nghĩa (tôi tự sửa cho thợ).

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.
I asked my brother to set up the smart speaker.
options: I got my brother set up the smart speaker.
I got my brother to set up the smart speaker.
I had the smart speaker set up my brother.
My brother asked me to set up the smart speaker.
questions.explain: Nhờ ai làm gì: get + sb + to V → I got my brother to set up… Câu 'got my brother set up' thiếu to; câu cuối đảo ngược người nhờ.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.
Someone is going to install a facial recognition system at our school gate.
options: Our school is going to install someone a facial recognition system at its gate.
Our school has a facial recognition system installing at its gate.
Our school is going to have a facial recognition system installed at its gate.
Our school had a facial recognition system installed at its gate.
questions.explain: Giữ thì tương lai gần (is going to) + have + sth + V3. 'had … installed' sai thì; 'installing' sai dạng; câu đầu sai cấu trúc.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.
It's the first time I've talked to a robot.
options: I talked to a robot for the first time long ago.
I have talked to robots many times before.
I didn't talk to a robot the first time.
I have never talked to a robot before.
questions.explain: It's the first time + S + have V3 = S + have never V3 + before. Các câu khác sai nghĩa.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.
People say that AI will change the way we learn.
options: AI is said changing the way we learn.
It is said that AI will change the way we learn.
It said that AI will change the way we learn.
AI says that people will change the way we learn.
questions.explain: Bị động với say: People say that… → It is said that… (hoặc AI is said to change…). 'is said changing' sai dạng; 'It said' sai nghĩa; câu cuối đổi nghĩa.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.
The teacher made the students check their essays with an AI tool.
options: The students were made check their essays with an AI tool by the teacher.
The teacher had their essays checked the students with an AI tool.
The students made the teacher check their essays with an AI tool.
The students were made to check their essays with an AI tool by the teacher.
questions.explain: Bị động của make sb do sth: sb + be made + to V. 'were made check' thiếu to; các câu còn lại sai cấu trúc hoặc đảo nghĩa.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences.
The robot can answer questions. It can also translate from different languages.
options: The robot can not only answer questions but also translate from different languages.
The robot can either answer questions or translate from different languages.
Although the robot can answer questions, it can translate from different languages.
The robot can neither answer questions nor translate from different languages.
questions.explain: Hai khả năng cùng có → not only … but also. either…or: chỉ một trong hai; although: tương phản vô lý; neither…nor: phủ định – sai nghĩa.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences.
AI tutors give instant feedback. Students can improve their work quickly.
options: Despite AI tutors' instant feedback, students can improve their work quickly.
AI tutors give instant feedback, but students can improve their work quickly.
Thanks to AI tutors' instant feedback, students can improve their work quickly.
Unless AI tutors give instant feedback, students can improve their work quickly.
questions.explain: Quan hệ nguyên nhân – kết quả tích cực → Thanks to + N. Despite/but: tương phản; unless: điều kiện phủ định – đều sai nghĩa.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences.
Home robots are very useful. Many families still can't afford them.
options: Although home robots are very useful, many families still can't afford them.
Because home robots are very useful, many families can't afford them.
Home robots are so useful that many families can't afford them.
Home robots are useful, so many families still can't afford them.
questions.explain: Hai ý tương phản (hữu ích nhưng không đủ tiền mua) → Although. because/so…that/so diễn đạt nguyên nhân – kết quả, sai logic.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences.
I didn't charge the robot. It stopped working in the middle of the task.
options: If I charged the robot, it wouldn't stop working in the middle of the task.
If I had charged the robot, it wouldn't have stopped working in the middle of the task.
If I hadn't charged the robot, it would have stopped working in the middle of the task.
Unless I had charged the robot, it wouldn't have stopped working in the middle of the task.
questions.explain: Giả định trái với quá khứ → câu điều kiện loại 3: If + had V3, would have V3, giữ đúng nghĩa (sạc thì đã không dừng). Loại 2 sai thì; câu 'hadn't charged' và 'Unless' đảo nghĩa.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (1).
questions.explain: one of the most useful + danh từ số nhiều: applications (ứng dụng) của AI. applicants: người nộp đơn; appliances: thiết bị gia dụng; applies: động từ.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (2).
questions.explain: Đại từ quan hệ thay cho vật (an AI tutor – một chương trình) làm chủ ngữ của adapts → which. whom làm tân ngữ; whose chỉ sở hữu; what không dùng sau danh từ.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (3).
questions.explain: have + sth + V3: have homework marked automatically (bài tập được chấm tự động).

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (4).
questions.explain: Câu trước nêu lợi ích, câu sau nêu nhược điểm → từ nối tương phản However. Moreover: bổ sung; Therefore/As a result: kết quả.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (5).
questions.explain: treat sb/sth as … = coi/đối xử như. deal phải có with; behave không có tân ngữ như vậy; think phải là think of … as.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (6).
questions.explain: Trước danh từ models cần tính từ: more advanced models (các mẫu tiên tiến hơn). advance/advancement là danh từ/động từ; advancing không hợp nghĩa.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (7).
questions.explain: be easy to + V nguyên mẫu: easy to operate (dễ vận hành).

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (8).
questions.explain: Sau tính từ sở hữu their cần danh từ: privacy (sự riêng tư).

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (9).
questions.explain: get + sb + to V: get a technician to repair them (nhờ thợ sửa).

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (10).
questions.explain: Nhấn mạnh so sánh hơn dùng much/far/a lot: much easier. 'more easier' thừa more; very/so không đứng trước dạng so sánh hơn.
